title: Add "show tabs from all windows / current window only" setting under Tab Organization
description:
Add a new toggle under the existing "Tab Organization" group in Settings → Tabs (components/SettingsPanel.js, mirrored in meridian-extension/components/SettingsPanel.js), letting the user choose whether the workspace grid shows tabs from all windows or just the current window.

Current state (from investigation):
- `tabsSection` (SettingsPanel.js:224) contains three groups: New Tab Behavior, **Tab Organization** (lines 400-429, currently just the "Group unsorted tabs by domain" checkbox, state var `groupByDomain`), and Thumbnails.
- The main workspace grid is populated in `meridian.js` `render()` (~line 397-409) via `chrome.tabs.query({})` at line 409 — this queries ALL windows, no filter. This is the query that needs to become conditional on the new setting.
- No existing per-window/all-windows concept exists in the settings schema today. For contrast, `components/sidebar.js:62` already scopes its own tab list to `{ currentWindow: true }`, so that's a precedent for the query shape to use.

Implementation:
1. Add a new checkbox/toggle to the "Tab Organization" group (pattern-match the existing "Group unsorted tabs by domain" toggle at SettingsPanel.js:400-429) — e.g. "Show tabs from all windows" (default: on/all windows, to preserve current behavior) or "Show only current window's tabs" — pick whichever phrasing matches the existing toggle style.
2. Add a new state var + default (pattern-match `groupByDomain`, SettingsPanel.js:198), persist via `chrome.storage.sync.set(...)`, and add the key to the load list at SettingsPanel.js:1157-1166. Dispatch the existing `settings-changed` custom event pattern so it propagates like `groupByDomain` does.
3. In `meridian.js` `render()` (~line 401-409), read the new setting from `chrome.storage.sync` (same place `groupByDomain` is already read at line 401) and pass `{ currentWindow: true }` vs `{}` to `chrome.tabs.query` accordingly.
4. Check whether other `chrome.tabs.query({})` call sites that feed the same grid/search UX (e.g. `utils/browserSearch.js`, `utils/thumbnailCache.js`) should also respect this setting for consistency, or should intentionally stay all-windows (e.g. thumbnail caching) — use judgment, but at minimum the main grid query must respect it.
5. Mirror all changes into `meridian-extension/` (components/SettingsPanel.js, meridian.js) per the project's existing source/extension parity pattern.
6. Default to preserving current behavior (all windows) so this is additive, not a behavior change, unless product intent is otherwise — flag if unsure.

Note: this touches SettingsPanel.js, which other background-panel tasks have recently modified — check current work-tree state / any in-progress tasks on that file before starting to avoid conflicts.
label: Feature

activity.content:
Implemented the new **Show tabs from all windows** setting under Tab Organization.

- Defaults to enabled, preserving the existing all-window grid behavior.
- Persists through `chrome.storage.sync` and dispatches `settings-changed` so the workspace rerenders immediately.
- Uses `{ currentWindow: true }` for the main grid tab query when disabled.
- Mirrored the SettingsPanel and Meridian changes into `meridian-extension/`.
- Left browser-search indexing and thumbnail caching global because they are shared background data stores rather than visible-grid selectors.
- Added `tests/tabWindowScope.test.mjs` regression coverage.

Validation: `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` — 139 passed; packaged parity and `git diff --check` also passed.
